benefits: USD 1,200 per month maintenance allowance, subject to increase to USD 1,500 or USD 2,000 depending on the host country
Books and replication allowance of USD 200 per month
One-time travel allowance: economy-class return air fare amounting to USD 1,000 for travel to the United Kingdom
Tuition support of up to USD 3,840 per year, generally within a total annual study budget
Monthly reimbursement for expenses above USD 200, recorded as vehicle loan-related expense
One month's stipend payable after arrival in the host country
eligibility: Only relevant students, faculty members, researchers and technicians are eligible

Applicants receiving any other scholarship, award, loan, stipend, allowance or subsidy from any government or other institution during the study period will not be eligible for the financial grant under this scheme
The degree must be completed within the official period allowed, as no extension of this scheme will be allowed in any case
requirements: Research proposal must be submitted alongside the application
Students already receiving any scholarship or stipend from any government or other institution are not eligible
Applicants must be free to take up the scholarship abroad, with no other funded study obligation
documents: Application form published on the HEC Overseas Scholarship Programme CSP Phase-III page
Academic documents as specified in the HEC batch announcement
selection_criteria: Selection is governed by the HEC Overseas Scholarship Programme CSP Phase-III rules and the published batch announcement
Tuition support and the overall allowance structure follow the HEC-provided cap rather than actual country living costs
coverage: Maintenance allowance capped at USD 1,600 per month, subject to the country-specific rates of USD 1,200, USD 1,500 or USD 2,000
Books and replication allowance of USD 200 per month
One-time travel allowance of USD 1,000 for a return economy air fare to the United Kingdom
Tuition support of up to USD 3,840 per year
application_method: Apply online through the HEC online application portal as published on the Overseas Scholarship Programme CSP Phase-III page, within the announced window
Attach the research proposal required by HEC with the application
Confirm you hold no other government or institutional scholarship, stipend, loan or subsidy during the study period
official.application_route: Apply through the HEC online application portal during the announced batch window, submitting the application form, academic documents and research proposal as specified in the batch announcement.
official.study_mode: Full-time study abroad for a Master's, M.Phil or Ph.D programme
official.citizenship_residency: Pakistani nationals for HEC's overseas scholarship schemes, with the overseas allocation governed by HEC's bilateral arrangements with the host country.
official.international_eligibility: Open to Pakistani nationals for eligible higher education abroad under the Phase-III arrangement; eligibility for a given batch is determined by HEC's country allocations.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any subject approved by HEC for the Phase-III bilateral programme, including research, with the scholar's faculty status assessing the merit and curriculum relevance of the proposed programme.
official.research_requirement: A research proposal must be submitted with the application, and the scholar's home faculty assesses the relevance of the proposed research programme.
official.duration: The official period allowed for the degree; no extension of the scheme is permitted in any case
official.description: The Overseas Scholarship Programme CSP Phase-III is a Higher Education Commission of Pakistan scheme supporting Pakistani nationals for Master's, M.Phil and Ph.D study abroad. Under the scheme HRCP types a letter to the financial institution of the airing institution and the student's employer attesting to his character. The Crawford Agreement is used to clarify that the student may transfer to a different track or institution within the scheme if the application is approved by the Accounting Authority. The student's employer may also authorise the institution to cover the tuition directly; in that case the tuition support function is capped at up to USD 3,840 per year.
official.program_type: Government of Pakistan scholarship for fully funded overseas higher education

applicant_utility.summary: This is a fully funded overseas scholarship for Pakistani nationals studying for a Master's, M.Phil or Ph.D abroad, and it is one of the rare overseas awards that combines a maintenance allowance with explicit tuition support up to USD 3,840 a year plus a books and replication allowance. The critical eligibility trap is that you cannot hold any other scholarship, stipend, loan, allowance or subsidy from a government or other institution while you study, so accepting this award ends any other funded obligation. The second constraint is duration: the degree must be finished within the officially allowed period, and HEC states no extension is permitted in any case, which means choosing a programme whose length fits the scheme matters as much as your research proposal. Because this record could not be verified against HEC's live pages on 10 October 2026, treat every figure in it as provisional and re-check the HEC Phase-III page before committing to a plan built on these numbers.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A Pakistani national admitted to a Master's, M.Phil or Ph.D programme abroad who can complete it within the officially allowed period and who holds no other government or institutional scholarship or subsidy.
application_readiness_checklist: Check that no other government or institutional scholarship, stipend, award, loan or subsidy is being received, because this makes you ineligible
Check the officially allowed duration of your degree against the scheme, since no extension is allowed
Prepare the research proposal that HEC requires with the application
Confirm with your home faculty that they will support the relevance of the proposed programme and research, since their assessment forms part of the process
Re-verify the current allowance rates and any batch timetable on the HEC Phase-III page before relying on them, since this record could not be confirmed live
common_rejection_risks: Holding any other scholarship or stipend during the study period, which makes you ineligible for the financial grant
Choosing a programme that cannot be completed within the official period, since no extension is allowed
Omitting the research proposal required by HEC
Assuming the monthly allowance is fixed: it varies between USD 1,200, USD 1,500 and USD 2,000 depending on the host country
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition above the USD 3,840 annual support, and any living costs above the monthly allowance at USD 1,200-2,000 depending on country. The scheme expects a tuition waiver or equivalent arrangement from the host institution, so uncovered costs can be significant.
